googlenet_params.description: GoogleNet has ~6.6M parameters. Exact count may vary slightly by torchvision version due to auxiliary classifiers.

googlenet_memory.description: FP32 = params * 4, FP16 = params * 2, INT8 = params * 1

googlenet_macs.description: Total MACs for GoogleNet with input (1, 3, 224, 224). Approximately 1.5 billion MACs. May vary slightly depending on whether auxiliary classifiers are included.

googlenet_conv2d_layers.description: Number of Conv2d layers in GoogleNet. The exact count depends on whether auxiliary classifiers are included (57 with aux, ~52 without).

googlenet_linear_layers.description: GoogleNet has 1 main FC layer (and 2 auxiliary FC layers if aux_logits=True).

operators.description: Expected operator types in MobileNetV2 ONNX model. Exact set may vary by opset and export method.

depthwise_convolutions.description: MobileNetV2 has 17 inverted residual blocks, each with a depthwise conv (group=C_in).

pointwise_convolutions.description: 1x1 pointwise convolutions. Each block has expansion + projection (2 per block), plus initial and final convs.

weight_data.description: Total weight data in MB (FP32). MobileNetV2 has ~3.4M params = ~13.6 MB in FP32.

hw2_3.description: ONNX Graph Transformation -- Tiling Linear Layers

classifier_1.description: 9216/64 = 144 input tiles, 4096/64 = 64 output tiles, 144 * 64 = 9216 MatMul ops

classifier_4.description: 4096/64 = 64 input tiles, 4096/64 = 64 output tiles, 64 * 64 = 4096 MatMul ops

classifier_6.description: 4096/64 = 64 input tiles, ceil(1000/64) = 16 output tiles (padded to 1024), 64 * 16 = 1024 MatMul ops. Output must be sliced back to 1000.

alexnet_tiling.description: After tiling, all 3 Gemm nodes should be replaced with MatMul-based subgraphs. Total MatMul nodes = 9216 + 4096 + 1024 = 14336.

verification.description: All 100 random input tests should pass with np.allclose(atol=1e-5). Max absolute error should be well below 1e-4.

criteria: Additional analysis beyond requirements (e.g., performance comparison, visualization)
